title: The dispatch door carries no model, so a cloud profile's recorded model rests on the factory agreeing
body: The sandbox dispatch door (cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts, mirrored in internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/record.go) carries no model or harness field: the profile's model is recorded in the dispatch marker and provenance but never crosses the seam, and the worker container's model comes from the factory's per-RUN config (RUN_MODEL / RUN_WORKER_MODEL, worker-boot.ts), which no run can name per attempt. Nothing checks the two agree, and because the factory's model is one per run, the economy tier's glm-5.3-flash cannot actually reach one container while the base tier's glm-5.3 reaches another — the per-tick tier selection gap worker-boot.ts itself documents as a Phase 3 candidate. Until the door carries the model (or something pins the two together), xte's 'proven by a run whose trace shows the expected provider per attempt' is provable per-run only, and the tier machinery this tick proved nameable records models the factory may not be serving.
